description: Any public GitHub repository as a Byteland street: its top contributors (bots left out) with commit counts, who pushed in the last 30 days (their lights are on), who lives in Byteland, the total number of contributors, and the image and page links (street: an SVG for READMEs, page: the street page). total is null when GitHub will not list the contributors of a very large history; then the people are this month's committers.

repo.description: Repository name. Leave it out for the owner’s skyline: their public repositories (no forks) by stars, lit when pushed in the last 30 days.

name: repo_street
title: A repository as a street
